atomic_claim_text: On the frozen 390-task controlled complete-gold companion, ORION mean recall is 0.979487 versus 0.666667 for the strongest confirmatory baseline.
bounded_claim_text: Controlled generated world only; TIER_B_committed with mandatory underpowered label relative to the 0.03 superiority margin; not external discovery superiority.

denominator.cannot_check_or_invalid_handling: 12 ORION CANNOT_CHECK tasks remain inside n=390; not recoded as zero without a label

discrepancies.text: RESULTS_SUMMARY_V1 cites n_result_records=16380 and a record digest, but the per-task JSONL is not in the public evidence tree, so 0.979487 cannot be regenerated from case vectors.

Claim ledger states achieved half-width 0.0496; RESULTS_SUMMARY achieved_tier_half_width is 0.05. Observed recall CI half-width is 0.004274. Underpowered label is the planning-tier vs margin rule, not the observed CI.

baseline_pressure.summary: Strongest frozen confirmatory baseline in-battery is protocol_driven_systematic_review at 0.666667. Official AutoResearchBench Wide was not executed by this verifier. Deep official probe is a later negative (hit rate 0) and is not a flagship positive.

denominator_statistics.summary: n=390 tasks, 3 nested repeats, 14 systems, 16380=390*3*14; task is the unit. 12 ORION CANNOT_CHECK remain in the 390-task denominator.

holdout_cross_host.summary: External Wide/cross-host reproduction was not run by this verifier.
